title: Autonomy Decision Packet
description: Machine-checkable schema for the Autonomy Decision Packet produced by The Autonomy Gate (RULE-06).

confidence.description: Decision confidence level. Independent of Build Handoff Pack status.

terminal_action.description: The last action the workflow executes. Must be descriptive — not a label.

justification.description: RULE-NN and GATE-NN citations that drove the verdict.

controls_required.description: Controls that must be in place before the workflow runs.

evidence_gaps.description: Named gaps. Required when confidence is MEDIUM or LOW.

conservative_route.description: Present when adversarial check revised the base verdict.

artifact_required.description: Template filename for the execution document produced in Phase 2.

build_handoff_pack.description: Status of the generated Build Handoff Pack. Independent of confidence.

operator_disposition.description: Operator disposition. Always PENDING when issued by the Gate.

allOf.description: Evidence gaps required when confidence is not HIGH
NO_AI surface pairs only with SOP_FIRST or HUMAN_ONLY
NOT_APPLICABLE pack pairs only with HUMAN_ONLY or SOP_FIRST
Gate-issued packets always have PENDING disposition
